modern: Either you live here and have already got used to it, or you are going away, and this was your own will; or you are dying and have done your duty. But besides these things there is nothing. Be cheerful, then.
original: Either thou livest here and hast already accustomed thyself to it, or thou art going away, and this was thy own will; or thou art dying and hast discharged thy duty. But besides these things there is nothing. Be of good cheer, then.
